title: Fisherman's Wharf

services.name: Full Day Fishing
services.desc: Our private charters are designed to provide all the fun and adventure of our daily full and half-day fishing trips but geared for people who want the entire boat for themselves and their party. We can accommodate up to 120 people on these charters and they are perfect for family reunions, corporate events, team building, school field trips, educational programs and much more. On these trips, you can expect extra levels of personal service and attention plus a one-of-a-kind, fun-filled day of memories. Oh, and great fishing too! You can find more pricing info below and remember, 302.645.TUNA for more details, questions and to book a private
